label: ercot99 state off fullspan
definition: ERCOT-99: cleared-share commitment-loading STATE weight OFF. Structural correction — the state weight prices loaded-at-scarcity gas at cost (CC w=0 median at the 2023 missed hours), but the measured DA ($327 p50) and RT ($488 p50) prices at those hours show loaded capacity clears at the offer wall; standing the wall down there suppressed real scarcity offer formation. Effect is entirely in the >=p97 bin (reach-gap verified). Full-span 2023-2025.
market_story: Wind/solar dispatch against ERCOT's own published NP6 uncurtailed potential (measured HSL bound; delivered basis matches EIA-930, endogenous curtailment ~5.6 vs reported 6.0 TWh in 2023). Merchant gas CCs run as committed units: the P1-native commitment bridge holds them at the measured 0.574 LSL through evening gaps shorter than a DA operating day because a restart costs more than riding the trough — commitment physics, not residual-buying. ST_GAS steamers carry the season-resolved net-load reliability drag that keeps aging steam online into summer peaks the way ERCOT reliability practice does. Coal PRB/lignite ride shoulder troughs on the take-or-pay fuel-passthrough sigmoid. CT peakers clear on the measured DAM cleared-share offer boundary in tight net-load bins (1.5-1.7% of load, under the C8 materiality floor). Batteries follow the measured AS-award reservation with the AS-to-energy deployment floor at the evening net-load ramp. Reserve holdout is the measured AS plan — now on the correct CST clock — minus the measured Load-Resource RRS and battery AS credits, priced through the pre-RTC+B non-releasable withholding design (rigid ECRS through 2024-07-31, the IMM-documented no-price-release design). ERCOT-99 correction: at high net load the committed gas that is loaded near its cap still offers its energy at the measured DAM offer wall, not at cost — the model now reproduces this by no longer standing the cleared-share econ wall down on the commitment-loading state (2023 DA/RT clear $327/$488 at those hours with the capacity loaded, so cost-pricing it was the wrong sign). A price-formation fix, not a forced-volume one: class volumes are essentially unchanged (C1/C2 PASS), only the 2023 scarcity-hour offer level moves.
